Name: Chubby Shane based on Ash's art
Author: rakimion2
Description:
I was brought back to Stardew Valley not long ago because of two reasons:

1. My friends wanted me to play with them.
2. Art of Shane done by [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile]Ash (a-substantial-trash-pile on tumblr)[/url] (Examples: [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile/756459894810574848/its-been-real-hot-out-lately-and-we-can-blame-one]1[/url] [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile/759630764816171008/sam-took-the-photo]2[/url] [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile/760717828671356928/my-farmer-has-never-wanted-anyone-more-in-his]3[/url] )

While it is implied in some conversations with Shane that he's a bit chubby, it doesn't translate well in the sprites or the portraits a lot.﻿..
SO! I went to Nexus to find a mod that changes that, and while I did find one made by ﻿[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KhwanZG?gameId=1303]KhwanZG[/url] , and I did love it, I was hoping for one more akin to the artstyle of the game...

And since I'm an artist myself, I thought... What the hell! Let's do it!

So this is a mod that changes all the sprites and portraits of Shane (Including JojoMart and winter sprites) to a more chubby version, more akin to the original Stardew Valley artsyle, based on Ash's art, and using KhwanZG's sprites as a base. It also changes Shane's island sprite and his sleeping sprite to a shirtless version based on [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile/756459894810574848/its-been-real-hot-out-lately-and-we-can-blame-one]this artwork[/url]~

﻿Installation:

I don't know much about how to make mods for SMAPI, so this is installed in the old manual method.

1. Extract the "Content" folder somewhere you can find it.
2. Make sure you backup every file with Shane's name inside the "Characters" and "Portaits" folders (just in case. You should be able to revert the mod's changes by verifying the files integrity and it'll redownload the changed files)
3. Copy and paste it in to your Stardew Valley directory
    (On steam that would be, usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley )
    (On XBox App that would be, usually: C:\Program Files\ModifiableWindowsApps\Stardew Valley )
    (On GOG that would be, usually: C:\Program Files (x86)\GOG Galaxy\Games\Stardew Valley )
4. Replace all files.
5. Done!

Uninstallation:

Either copy and paste the backup files you saved, or verify the file integrity of the files.


Credits:

I wish to offer credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KhwanZG?gameId=1303]KhwanZG[/url] for the original mod that I used as a base, and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/a-substantial-trash-pile]Ash[/url] for their art!
